samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse Detection Module</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="INITIAL">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WAIT_FOR_ONE">Waiting for '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WAIT_FOR_ZERO">Waiting for '0' after detecting '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="PULSE_END">End of pulse detected.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="[2:0]">State register.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[2:0]">Next state register.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            <case>
                <when condition="~rst_n">
                    <assign next_state = INITIAL;
                           data_out = 1'b0;
                </when>
                <when condition="state == INITIAL">
                    <if condition="data_in == 1'b1">
                        <assign next_state = WAIT_FOR_ZERO;
                               data_out = 1'b0;
                    </if>
                    else begin
                        <assign next_state = INITIAL;
                               data_out = 1'b0;
                    end
                </when>
                <when condition="state == WAIT_FOR_ZERO">
                    <if condition="data_in == 1'b0">
                        <assign next_state = PULSE_END;
                               data_out = 1'b1;
                    </if>
                    else begin
                        <assign next_state = WAIT_FOR_ZERO;
                               data_out = 1'b0;
                    end
                </when>
                <when condition="state == PULSE_END">
                    <if condition="data_in == 1'b0">
                        <assign next_state = INITIAL;
                               data_out = 1'b0;
                    </if>
                    else begin
                        <assign next_state = WAIT_FOR_ZERO;
                               data_out = 1'b0;
                    end
                </when>
                default: begin
                    <assign next_state = INITIAL;
                           data_out = 1'b0;
                end
            </case>
        </always_comb>
        
        <always_ff posedge clk or negedge rst_n>
            <if condition="~rst_n">
                <assign state <= INITIAL;
            </if>
            else begin
                <assign state <= next_state;
            end
        </always_ff>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Sequential logic for pulse detection based on the state machine.</implementation>
</module>
